newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA LIISING TO SIGN SYNDICATED LOAN DEAL.
newsitem.headline: HANSA LIISING TO SIGN SYNDICATED LOAN DEAL.

text.p: Hansapank's leasing arm, Hansaliising, will sign an agreement for a 50 million German mark syndicated loan August 8 in Riga, Hansapank said on Monday.
The interest rate on the three-year loan will be 0.6 percent over the German Libor rate," Erki Raasuke, head of Hansapank's interest rates and financial risks department told Reuters.
The loan is guaranteed by Hanspank.
"This is Hansapank's third time this year in the market and it was again succesful with the original 40 million mark loan over-subscribed," he added.
The syndicated loan was organised by Gesellschaft Berlin with CitiBank and S-E Banken as co-arrangers.
"In all, 13 banks contributed to the loan," Raasuke added.
Hansaliising decided to take the full 50 million marks instead of the earlier 40 million marks to help it with its international expansion to Latvia and Lithuania.
